recruiterCard.summary: Built an auditable ledger-to-bank reconciliation, demonstrated on synthetic data, that standardizes fields, matches records and reports exceptions.
impactBullets: Standardized ledger and bank fields, then matched records exactly before falling back to conservative rules.
Produced exception and summary reports so every unmatched or ambiguous record is visible for review.
Kept the workflow repeatable on synthetic data so results can be rerun and checked.
